themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints have spiked to 8 complaints THIS WEEK, up from a baseline of 0.1 complaints per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 6,300% increase (z-score: 23.81)—suggesting a coordinated campaign or sudden enforcement gap in Midwood/Ocean Parkway.
evidence: 8 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 23.81 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Spike represents 6,300% increase from historical norm
reporting_angles: Ground canvass: photograph proliferation of illegal posters across key corridors (Coney Island Ave, Ocean Parkway, Flatbush Ave); identify what's being posted (political, commercial, ads)
Interview NYC Parks or Sanitation on enforcement response and whether they've detected a surge or pattern

themes_detail.label: Construction/Plumbing Crisis
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints jumped to 81 complaints LAST WEEK, up 529% from an 8-week average of 12.9 complaints per week (z-score: 19.38), indicating either a localized infrastructure failure, water main issue, or building renovation wave affecting residents.
evidence: 81 construction/plumbing complaints LAST WEEK vs. 12.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 19.38 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Spike of 529% above baseline suggests concentrated disruption rather than diffuse pattern
reporting_angles: Contact DEP to determine if there's an active water main break, valve repair, or other citywide work in the district; map complaint locations to identify geographic concentration
Interview residents on specific plumbing failures (backups, no water, burst pipes) and whether complaints cluster around particular blocks or building types

themes_detail.label: Water System Strain
themes_detail.summary: Water system complaints spiked to 59 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO, up 242% from an 8-week average of 17.2 complaints per week (z-score: 4.91), suggesting potential distribution network stress or localized supply issues in the district.
evidence: 59 water system complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 17.2 weekly baseline (8-week average)
Z-score of 4.91 indicates statistically significant spike
Spike of 242% above baseline, though timing is older than construction/plumbing spike
reporting_angles: Check DEP records for any major water main work, valve replacements, or contamination alerts issued 2–3 weeks ago in Midwood or surrounding areas
Interview residents on symptoms (low pressure, discolored water, intermittent supply) and cross-reference with plumbing complaints (may be related infrastructure event)

themes_detail.label: Obstruction & Lot Condition Surge
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints jumped to 14 LAST WEEK (up 239% from 4.1 weekly average, z-score: 5.84) and lot condition complaints hit 3 LAST WEEK (up 2,300% from 0.1 weekly average, z-score: 8.69), suggesting possible illegal dumping, abandoned property neglect, or street encroachments concentrated on specific blocks.
evidence: 14 obstruction complaints LAST WEEK vs. 4.1 weekly baseline (239% spike, z-score: 5.84)
3 lot condition complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2,300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
Combined signal suggests environmental blight and public space encroachment affecting same area
reporting_angles: Map complaint addresses to identify whether obstructions and lot issues are clustered on specific blocks or near particular properties; photograph conditions
Interview DSNY and Parks Enforcement on whether they've observed a specific dumping site, illegally occupied lot, or street vendor encroachment activity

themes_detail.label: Multiple Historic District Rezonings in Motion
themes_detail.summary: Two historic district designations (Ditmas Park West and Beverley Square West) plus three ULURP rezonings are in active review, creating potential for development-driven displacement, affordability pressure, and construction disruption over the next 6–12 months in Midwood/Ocean Parkway.
evidence: Ditmas Park West Historic District in City Council review phase (Non-ULURP)
Beverley Square West Historic District in City Council review phase (Non-ULURP)
Three active ULURP rezonings: 1455 Coney Island Ave, 2586 Nostrand Ave, 1584 Flatbush Ave
reporting_angles: Attend upcoming City Council hearings on historic district designations; interview residents on displacement concerns and affordability impacts
Cross-check ULURP applications with DOB alteration permits (239 filed in past 90 days) to assess whether rezoning speculation is already driving renovation activity
